description: Open tasks scheduled to end within the next N days (today included), in the connected LoopGantt ACCOUNT (requires signing in to LoopGantt, or an API key), earliest end first.

agent.description: Only tasks this bot owns (its exact agentLabel, e.g. "qa-bot"), or 'none' for tasks no bot owns

today.description: Today's date YYYY-MM-DD in the user's time zone (default: UTC today)

name: list_due_soon
